description:
Dive into Fading Echo on PlayStation 5!

Your adventure begins here: https://store.playstation.com/concept/10014310/

Step into Fading Echo, a fast-paced elemental action-adventure RPG where a world on the brink is yours to save.

Play as One, a young Legend with a tangled past. As the Paradox Corruption spreads across Corel and reality begins to collapse, she must fight to save her disappearing world.

Master powerful Ætheric abilities, weaponize water, and trigger elemental reactions as you slide, shift, and smash your way through combat, puzzles, and the fractured realities of Corel.

Corel is fading. Will you rise to save it?

The loop always resets. You don't. 🧠🛰️ 

Rivage is an immersive sci-fi puzzle adventure set aboard the A.R.E.S. space station trapped in a space phenomenon.  

You play as Miranda, a researcher stuck in an infinite time loop aboard the A.R.E.S. space station. Your crew has vanished, leaving only their journals, recordings, and personal belongings behind. Explore the station and solve puzzles to piece together what happened. 

Rivage is available now on PlayStation 5.
